name: eNAM (National Agriculture Market)
description: Online trading platform integrating APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
eligibility: Farmers, traders, and FPOs registered with linked APMC mandis.
benefits: Better price discovery, transparent bidding, wider buyer reach, reduced intermediaries.
application_steps: Link APMC mandi and bank account.
Payment settled to farmer account post-trade.
processing_time: Trade settlement as per mandi rules (typically within mandated days).
fees: Transaction charges as per APMC bye-laws; platform access free for farmers.
office_locator_info: Linked APMC mandis across participating states.

faq.a: Most states with APMC integration; check the mandi list on the portal.

ai_summary: eNAM is a unified online agriculture trading platform linking APMC mandis for transparent price discovery.
ai_explanation: eNAM lets farmers and traders transact across mandis through e-auction, improving price discovery and reducing middlemen. Farmers register free and link their mandi and bank account; traders need a licence.
common_questions: How do I sell on eNAM?
suggested_followups: How do I grade my produce for eNAM?
